subject: planner: Make SET_VAR hints restore the correct session variable values after execution. (#61165)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its parent. `planner/Optimize` now records the pre-hint session *state* via `SysVar.GetStateValue` when available (instead of the potentially computed `GetSession`/`GetSessionOrGlobalSystemVar` value), which fixes cases like `@@timestamp` default behavior (getter returns a per-statement cached current time) and also aligns with `rand_seed1/2` state restoration. Restore still happens via `StmtCtx.SetVarHintRestore` + `ResetContextOfStmt` calling `SetSystemVar` on the saved value. Added tests assert `timestamp` resumes updating after statement execution for both direct hints and SQL bindings. No Blocker/High issues found in planner/sessionctx behavior for this change.
